reader.py asserts the GET route and startDate=2026-10-01, endDate=2026-10-07, pageSize=100. output.json records cursors null/A/B and decoded log-1/log-2 IDs across a populated, empty, and populated page.
The three-page fixture returns complete=true only after the final response omits nextPageToken. It makes exactly three mock transport requests; public DNS probe is denied.

output.json records partial results for page, item, time, and repeated-token limits, plus typed MissingStartDate and ListLogFilesPermissionDenied errors. A live operator must preserve partial results, investigate repeated cursors, and verify tenant permission before retrying.
